 West Ham United v Preston North End confirmed lineups and team news
 Matt Gibbs
 Published: 1 hour ago
 Scott Parker takes charge of his first home game at West Ham United this afternoon as Preston North End make the journey to London. 
 The Hammers start the weekend a point outside of the Championship play-offs following a four-game winless run.
Parker was in the dugout for West Ham's 3-3 draw at Cardiff City, before suffering a 2-1 defeat at the hands of Blackburn Rovers last time out.
Visitors Preston find themselves at the bottom of the table despite their 1-0 win against Southampton before the international break.
